verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a consumer agent product with a public web presence, so the axis applies. A runtime probe found no public llms.txt or API spec: muse.ai/llms.txt returned HTTP 401 behind an auth wall, and no MCP discovery or other developer docs surface exists. Nothing else in the pack describes agent-readable documentation, and Muse's ability to build its own connectors is a different capability that does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
